profile.description: Active Oct. 1-3, 2026 family fair with a Mini Carnival & Family Fun Zone. Town insurance/liability was initially cited as blocking inflatables, but the latest organizer reply says she would take Adventure Zone's information back to the Town for reconsideration.

notes.subject: Latest 2026 status - Lyssa taking proposal back to Town
notes.body: Lyssa Harder first replied Aug. 18, 2026 that the Town of Payson would not allow inflatables because of insurance liability. Adventure Zone provided additional safety/insurance information, and Lyssa's latest reply on Aug. 19 was: 'Let me go to the Town and see what they say!' No later response was found in the reviewed Gmail history. Current official fair information confirms the event remains active Oct. 1-3, 2026 and now advertises a Mini Carnival & Family Fun Zone, with a stated goal of growing the carnival experience. Do not mark this as a hard decline yet; follow up on the Town decision.

followUps.label: Ask Lyssa what the Town decided
followUps.reason: The fair is still upcoming and Lyssa's latest response said she would take Adventure Zone's information back to the Town. Check the outcome before assuming inflatables are prohibited for 2026.
